text: {"lessons":["A stock’s recent price moves are not enough reason to buy; my Stock B purchase was followed by another buy at a much higher price, so I should consider valuation and risk before adding.","Selling Stock A after steep losses shows I need a plan for each holding before prices fall, rather than making decisions reactively.","Frequent checking and trading can encourage impulsive moves; I should keep my apartment goal and long-term plan in mind and make deliberate decisions."]}
